title: Scriptorium Note v1
description: A free-text human note or idea normalized by a supported or optional capture adapter and ingested into Provenance by the host sync layer (see specs/sync-layer.md §4). Carries `private` so personal-zone notes (Inbox/, _planning/) are usable as project context and local search but excluded from the profile/persona pipeline and kept in the protected layer.

note_id.description: Stable, collision-safe id; minted by the producer or host-stamped on first ingest.

source.description: Where this v1 note originated: an optional Obsidian adapter, the optional openclaw compatibility path, or an agent/host workflow. These enum values do not make either optional integration a core dependency.

private.description: True for personal-zone notes (Inbox/, _planning/): ingested to memory but excluded from profile generation and stored protected. Defaults to true for those zones.

origin_path.description: Original Markdown-workspace-relative path, if materialized from a file.
